personas.ai_literacy_level: High: Strong understanding of generative AI systems, training data, and common generation artifacts. Frequently recognises stylistic, structural, or visual indicators associated with AI-generated content.
personas.prior_ai_use: None: No meaningful prior interaction with generative AI tools.
personas.online_content_skepticism: Moderate: Sometimes questions the reliability or authenticity of online content, especially when inconsistencies or unusual details are noticeable.
personas.attention_to_detail: High: Carefully analyses wording, structure, visual elements, and contextual consistency before making a judgement.
personas.prior_exposure_to_misinformation: Low: Limited prior exposure to misinformation or manipulated media discussions.
